title: Indigen World shared contract definitions
description: Reusable identifiers, enums, references, governance metadata and record lifecycle shared across all Indigen World entity contracts. This file is canonical; language and framework models are derived from it.

identifier.description: Stable record identifier (e.g. Firestore document id).

languageCode.description: BCP 47 / ISO 639-3 language code. Kasem is 'xsm'.

reference.description: Typed pointer to another record by collection and id.

validationStatus.description: Lifecycle of a content record through community validation.

consentStatus.description: State of consent attached to a record or contributor.

licence.description: Licence applied to a record. 'undetermined' is the default until a governance decision is recorded; cultural material must not inherit an ordinary source-code licence. See docs/governance/licensing-status.md.

culturalPermissionTier.description: How widely a record may be exposed, from most to least open.

collectionKind.description: Canonical destination in the mobile Collection library.

campaignStatus.description: Lifecycle of a creator campaign. The interface reacts to this value; submission availability is derived from it, never hardcoded in the client.

creatorApplicationStatus.description: Lifecycle of a founding-creator application through onboarding review.

submissionStatus.description: Lifecycle of a creator content submission through moderation and publication.

paymentStatus.description: Lifecycle of a reward payout. Payout detail lives in a restricted collection.

publicationStatus.description: Visibility of an approved published-content record consumed by the mobile app.

creatorConsentScope.description: A grantable permission scope on a creator submission. Publication, promotion and AI-training are always separate, opt-in decisions.

creatorReference.description: Human-readable creator/application reference number, e.g. KCC-2026-0001.

governanceMetadata.description: Community-governance metadata that must travel with every content record. See docs/governance/data-safety.md.

source.description: Origin of the record (contributor submission, elder recording, approved corpus, etc.).

language.description: Language cell the record belongs to.

dialect.description: Dialect, when known; null when dialect-neutral or unknown.

validator.description: Validator who last acted on the record. Null until reviewed.

consent.description: Consent record governing this content, when one applies.

recordLifecycle.description: Creation, modification, version and audit trail shared by all records.

version.description: Monotonically increasing schema/content version for the record.

auditRefs.description: References to audit-log entries recording changes to this record.
